note: Routes proven to deliver the packet they promise. A record here is the ONLY thing that grants commercial authority — checkout creation, consumer payment authority, sponsored entitlement, packet generation, packet-credit consumption and participant delivery all read it, and the absence of a record is a refusal rather than a gap. Adding a row is an assertion that a real artifact was produced and inspected, so every row must name the proof that established it and the date. The list is empty because nothing has been proven yet: the only builder the direct-consumer paid path calls returns a text/plain summary for every route.
whatIsNeverEnoughOnItsOwn: an evaluator result code, which says the participant is eligible and not that a packet exists
a packet plan, which says which facts a packet would need and not that anything renders one
a packet family name, which is a legal statement about what a route produces and not evidence it was built
legacy-jurisdiction status, which classifies a state and says nothing about one route inside it
paymentAllowed copied from a profile, which is a stored opinion where a present fact is required
